recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source correction to an active narrative page and aligns current profiling guidance with the published issue without broadening the current profiling model.
issue_request: FHIR-14538 was a Published FHIR-I STU3 clarification resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked the Profiling FHIR limitations text to say profiles cannot specify default values, meanings, or more specific names for elements in the base specification/profiles.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 13408, represented in git by commit 365e2bf447d06ee716d94fa3d4024385a67d714f. That commit changed source/profiling.html, but the applied wording only mentioned elements defined in the base specification and omitted the profile-derived-base part of the resolution.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists profiling.html as the active Profiling FHIR page. The current profiling page discusses constraining another profile and later descriptive-element guidance says base resource or profile guidance cannot be invalidated, but those sections did not supersede the need for the Limitations of Use bullets to include base profiles. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community record.
reconciliation: Updated source/profiling.html so both relevant Limitations of Use bullets refer to elements defined in the base specification or a base profile, and closed the existing parenthetical note on the same edited line.
source_changes: source/profiling.html:306-307 now says profiles cannot specify default values/meanings or change names for elements defined in the base specification or a base profile.

related_jiras.note: Later profiling guidance allows limited descriptive-element refinement while confirming inherited base resource or profile guidance cannot be invalidated.
Related inherited-property suppression work was considered but belongs to a separate tooling/extension question.
